strategies.name: box_setup_deviation_retest

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we get a move below this range and then back into the range
entry_sequence.action: Define the setup when price deviates outside the range and then reclaims back into it; for long, deviate below the range and reclaim back inside, and for short, deviate above the range and reclaim back inside.
entry_sequence.rationale: The deviation back into the range marks the manipulation phase of the box setup.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: aggress it down aggressive up this is the deviation from the range
entry_sequence.action: Use the aggressive move away from the deviation as confirmation of the reclaim; for long, aggressive down then aggressive up, and for short, aggressive up then aggressive down.
entry_sequence.rationale: The aggressive return suggests rejection of the deviation.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: accumulation manipulation I want to see distribution
entry_sequence.action: Frame the trade as a box setup sequence of accumulation, manipulation, then distribution before entry.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker uses this sequence to define the setup logic.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: ideally I'm looking for a retest of this manipulation
entry_sequence.action: Wait for a retest of the manipulation/deviation area before entering; for long, retest the lower deviation area, and for short, retest the upper deviation area.
entry_sequence.rationale: The retest gives the actual entry location after the reclaim.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: be reaching for the other side here
entry_sequence.action: Enter on the retest for a move toward the opposite side of the range; for long, target the upper side, and for short, target the lower side.
entry_sequence.rationale: The box setup aims for expansion across the range to the opposite side.

stop.rationale: The speaker does not state a structural initial stop for this scoped box setup segment.

strategies.stop_management: Take partials as price moves toward the opposite side and the example shows the possibility of moving the stop to break even after partials.

targets.transcript_quote: be reaching for the other side here
targets.rationale: The speaker says the setup is looking for price to reach the other side of the range.

targets.transcript_quote: we have all this liquidity resting above
targets.rationale: The move is intended to reach the liquidity resting above the range.

confluences.transcript_quote: move below this range and then back into the range

confluences.name: no_prior_ltf_stop_raid_required
confluences.description: This box setup can be taken even without a prior lower-timeframe stop raid or structure shift before entry.

confluences.name: requires_clear_manipulation_before_move
confluences.description: The speaker still wants to see a clear lower-timeframe liquidity event tied to the move, even if not a prior stop raid in the standard checklist format.
